papers.title: Controlling Smart Inverters using Proxies: A Chance-Constrained DNN-based Approach
papers.abstract: Coordinating inverters at scale under uncertainty is the desideratum for integrating renewables in distribution grids. Unless load demands and solar generation are telemetered frequently, controlling inverters given approximate grid conditions or proxies thereof becomes a key specification. Although deep neural networks (DNNs) can learn optimal inverter schedules, guaranteeing feasibility is largely elusive. Rather than training DNNs to imitate already computed optimal power flow (OPF) solutions, this work integrates DNN-based inverter policies into the OPF. The proposed DNNs are trained through two OPF alternatives that confine voltage deviations on the average and as a convex restriction of chance constraints. The trained DNNs can be driven by partial, noisy, or proxy descriptors of the current grid conditions. This is important when OPF has to be solved for an unobservable feeder. DNN weights are trained via back-propagation and upon differentiating the AC power flow equations assuming the network model is known. Otherwise, a gradient-free variant is put forth. The latter is relevant when inverters are controlled by an aggregator having access only to a power flow solver or a digital twin of the feeder. Numerical tests compare the DNN-based inverter control schemes with the optimal inverter setpoints in terms of optimality and feasibility.

summary_en.motivation: To coordinate inverters in distribution grids under uncertainty without frequent telemetry.
summary_en.method: DNN-based inverter policies are integrated into optimal power flow, trained via back-propagation through power flow equations or gradient-free methods.
summary_en.result: The DNN schemes achieve near-optimal setpoints while maintaining feasibility and robustness to proxy inputs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical tests on distribution feeder models compare optimality and feasibility of DNN versus optimal dispatch.

papers.title: In Situ High‐Energy Synchrotron X‐Ray Diffraction Reveals the Role of Texture on the Activation of Slip and Twinning during Deformation of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Ti–6Al–4V
papers.abstract: The deformation behavior of Ti–6Al–4V processed by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) is investigated by in situ high‐energy synchrotron X‐ray diffraction (HEXRD) during uniaxial compression. The initial microstructure of the alloy consists of a fine lamellar α + β microstructure where α lamellae are separated by thin continuous β layers within prior β grains. The anisotropy of the alloy is studied in the deformation direction using samples that are built at the angles of 0°, 45°, and 90° with respect to the LPBF base plate. The sample oriented at 0° presents higher strength–ductility trade‐off compared with the conditions oriented at 45° and 90°. The in situ HEXRD experiments continuously reveal the microstructure response during deformation and that the textures for each orientation are associated with a different activation sequence of deformation mechanisms.

summary_en.motivation: To understand the anisotropic deformation behavior of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V by correlating texture with slip and twinning activation.
summary_en.method: In situ high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction during uniaxial compression of samples built at 0°, 45°, and 90° orientations.
summary_en.result: The 0° orientation exhibits superior strength-ductility trade-off, and texture governs the activation sequence of deformation mechanisms.
summary_en.validation: In situ HEXRD experiments continuously captured microstructure evolution during deformation.

papers.title: Experimental and computational evaluation of tensile properties of additively manufactured hexa- and tetrachiral auxetic cellular structures
papers.abstract: The auxetic cellular structures with two different chiral geometries (tetrachiral and hexachiral) were fabricated using laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) technology from two different materials (aluminium alloy AlSi10Mg and stainless steel AISI 316L). The specimen's microstructure, porosity and surface texture were observed by X-ray diffraction, optical and electron microscopy and micro-computed tomography. The mechanical properties of all specimens were determined experimentally with a simple tensile test. The results show that hexachiral and tetrachiral auxetic structures have similar initial stiffness, whereas the former provides a more ductile response with more than four times larger failure strain. The AISI316L steel provides for a much more ductile response than AlSi10Mg at comparable normalised load-carrying capability. The samples' deformation behaviour was analysed with the digital image correlation and tracking method, where it was shown that hexachiral samples exhibit a lower Poisson's ratio. The experimental results were used to validate the corresponding computational models, providing a more detailed analysis of deformation behaviour. They allow for cost-effective parametric studies and the development of new optimised chiral geometries.

summary_en.motivation: To compare the tensile properties of tetrachiral and hexachiral auxetic cellular structures fabricated by LPBF.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated from AlSi10Mg and AISI 316L using LPBF, and tensile tests with DIC were performed to characterize mechanical behavior.
summary_en.result: Hexachiral structures exhibited over four times larger failure strain than tetrachiral ones, with AISI 316L providing more ductile response.
summary_en.validation: Experimental tensile data and DIC measurements validated finite element models.

papers.title: An improved 2-pentanone low to high-temperature kinetic model using Bayesian Optimization algorithm

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用贝叶斯优化进行化学动力学模型校准，与生物力学或植入物设计中的有限元代理建模无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on chemical kinetic model optimization, not on surrogate modeling for structural mechanics, lacks biomedical context, and does not address implant design or biomechanics constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高2-戊酮燃烧动力学模型的预测精度
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯优化算法自动校准反应速率参数
summary_zh.result: 优化后的模型在宽温度范围内与实验数据吻合更好

summary_en.motivation: To improve the predictive accuracy of the 2-pentanone combustion kinetic model across a wide temperature range.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization algorithm is employed to automatically calibrate reaction rate parameters against experimental data.
summary_en.result: The optimized model shows significantly improved agreement with experimental measurements from low to high temperatures.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing model predictions with published experimental data for ignition delay times and species concentrations.
